title: AzureOpenAI Configuration Error
body:
I am trying to configure azure openai llm. After setting the config.py file, I am getting below error:

ERROR:    Exception in ASGI application

Can someone share the config.py with respect to azure openai llm

linked_prs.title: Hotfix for #422 & # 427 : LLM provider = azureopenai when using detailed report mode
linked_prs.body: Hotfix for #422 & #427  Detailed report azureopenai support plus azureopenai LLM settings documentation improvement.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue explicitly references configuring an LLM provider (Azure OpenAI) and reports an error related to its integration, which falls under "Incompatibility with LLM providers" and "Model access misconfiguration" in the agent issue taxonomy.
